title: Health Resort west wing room 219 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 219 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing room 219 key (W219 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing room 219.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the Quest I Need More Power when you don't have a Health Resort west wing room 220 key

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- In the lighthouse at the pier, on the second floor on top of a broken wooden box.

- In a key rack in the utility room next to west wing room 227 at the health resort.

- In the key rack near the central stairs on the second floor of the east wing at the health resort.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 219 of the West Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Blue keycard spawn location
- 1x Weapon cabinet
- 1x Weapon box (6x4)
- 1x BNTI Module-3M body armor spawn
- 1x Weapon spawn (AK-74N)
- Loose loot (Currency, , Meds, Medical supplies)
